title: First Connection between Cold Gas in Emission and Absorption: CO Emission from a Galaxy-Quasar Pair
question: Does the z = 0.101 galaxy toward PKS 0439-433 emit CO(1-0), and does the molecular absorption toward the quasar arise from its molecular disk or from its CGM?

what.value: Stellar mass log M*/Msun = 10.01 ± 0.02 and SFR ≈ 1.5 Msun/yr

evidence.quote: the stellar mass of the spiral galaxy has been estimated to be log[M ⋆ /M ⊙ ] = 10.01 ± 0.02

what.value: HI 3-sigma upper limit on atomic gas mass of 3×10^9 Msun

evidence.quote: yields a 3-σ upper limit of 3×10 [9] M ⊙ on its atomic gas mass

what.value: H2 column density ≈ (4.1 ± 0.5)×10^16 cm^-2 from UV absorption

recipe.method: Combine three continuum spws, detect quasar, self-calibrate (phase, then phase+amplitude)

recipe.goal: Make CO(1-0) cube and moment maps
recipe.method: clean cube with Briggs robust 0.5, 20 km/s channels; first moment with immoments for >3σ emission
Infinitely thin exponential disk with flat rotation curve, convolved with beam and compared with data cube
key_parameters: free parameters: I0, R_D, inclination, PA, center (3 coords), v_max
assumptions: zero intrinsic velocity dispersion, flat rotation curve

recipe.method: M_mol = alpha_CO L'CO with helium correction; M_dyn ~ V^2 R/G
assumptions: alpha_CO = 4.3 Msun (K km/s pc^2)^-1 (Bolatto et al. 2013); R ≈ 10 kpc

recipe.method: Compare absorption component velocities to disk rotation curve and extrapolate surface density to sightline
assumptions: covering fraction <10%, representative H2 column, gas within 20 kpc sphere

evidence.quote: We obtain an integrated CO(1−0) flux density of 1.46 ± 0.07 Jy km s [−][1]
we find an inclination angle of 67 [+6] −5 [degrees,]
yields a gas consumption timescale of ≈ 2.8 Gyr
the absorbing molecular component contains ≲ 10 [5] M ⊙ of gas

not_stated_but_needed: MCMC priors, chain length, step sizes and likelihood
on-source time, number of antennas, baselines
how R_D and the 10 kpc disk radius were derived
exact CO line luminosity conversion details
how the SFR of 1.5 was adopted vs 0.53
missing_for_reproduction: CASA version and exact imaging parameters
score_reason: Single compact-array dataset and simple recipe, but key imaging and MCMC details missing and custom code unreleased.
rediscovery_reason: Data are public, the recipe is short, and the results (flux, M_mol, v_rot) are numeric, though the MCMC model needs reimplementation.
